verdict.rationale: Built-in physics is a fair axis for a game engine, but nothing in the evidence pack mentions rigid bodies, colliders, collision detection, raycasts, or any physics system. The only related material is generic marketing ('Build 2D and 3D games'), which does not document a physics capability.

support.subject: As a game developer, built-in physics — rigid bodies, collisions, raycasts — works out of the box
